title: What People Say
description: Not bribed, I promise. Just real words from real humans.

data.text: Rarely do you come across someone who’s truly self-taught and has mastered the craft through pure dedication. Arindam is one of those people. Whether it’s a small UI tweak or a major new feature, he always dives deep into every detail, ensuring each flow is polished and delivered flawlessly.
